title: Leaked documents: OpenAI's adjusted operating margin improved from -150% to -109% from Q2 to Q3 (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Berber Jin / Wall Street Journal: Leaked documents: OpenAI's adjusted operating margin improved from -150% to -109% from Q2 to Q3 — The company improved its adjusted operating margin but remains far off from profitability — OpenAI grew revenue by roughly 50% to $10 billion from the second to the third quarter …
contentText:
Berber Jin / Wall Street Journal :

Leaked documents: OpenAI's adjusted operating margin improved from -150% to -109% from Q2 to Q3   —  The company improved its adjusted operating margin but remains far off from profitability  —  OpenAI grew revenue by roughly 50% to $10 billion from the second to the third quarter …
